subject.title: improve(ui): restyle composer send button as filled accent circle

question: Should Send remain aligned with the current muted composer toolbar, or become the filled accent primary action proposed by this PR?
rationale: The implementation is sound and follows the documented primary-action principle, but the visual hierarchy of the main chat control is a deliberate design-system choice and the protected maintainer label requires explicit ownership.

options.title: Adopt filled Send
options.body: Refresh the patch onto current main and preserve the filled accent hierarchy while matching the current composer geometry and state model.

options.title: Keep muted Send
options.body: Retain current main’s quieter toolbar-aligned treatment and close the proposal without merging the visual change.

recommendation.title: Adopt filled Send
recommendation.body: Refresh the patch onto current main and preserve the filled accent hierarchy while matching the current composer geometry and state model.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest available current-main Control UI history and authored the documented, proof-backed design proposal.
